intro: Benin is a narrow country stretching from lagoons on the Atlantic to savanna in the north.

chapters.title: Land
text: The south has lagoons and Ganvié, a village built on stilts in Lake Nokoué. The north has the Atakora hills and Pendjari National Park, one of the last refuges of West African lions.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The south has two rainy seasons; the north one.

keyTerms.meaning: Houses built on poles above water.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Benin's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
